decisions.reason: Selecting the revised physical design does not change the requirement to deliver a basic wiring plan or establish any specific wiring-plan modification.
The design selection may inform later component choices, but the source does not change the component-selection deliverable, selection goal, or any specific component requirement.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording the selected design reference and the requirement that the pour spot face the baristas; no additional change is required.
The source message's green-accent requirement is already represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event, and the broader layout decision adds no further color-scheme change.
The retained wording and Karla's Matcha Mixer name are already represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event; the layout modification adds no further branding change.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event already captures the DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity, so no additional propagated MODIFY is necessary.
Adopting the revised design is consistent with a simpler V1, but the client does not change the existing rapid-prototype priority or off-the-shelf sourcing policy.
The deep-well form is already captured by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event, and the general design selection adds no further bowl-form update.
The splash-control target is already captured by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event, and the layout design-direction update adds no additional splash-control state change.
